note: Team-insider ledger: how each India Pega team is structured, who the visible people are, what they appear to build, and what working there is like. Built from search-index LinkedIn profile text (not live LinkedIn verification), public posts, employer postings and employee-review sites. Review ratings are self-selected and vary by team and manager; treat them as signals to ask about, not facts about the specific team you would join. No person was contacted.
candidate_lens: About 4 years Pega, CSA + CSSA, Kafka/REST/SFTP integrations, auto-finance collections domain, Bengaluru preferred.

companies.name: Pegasystems India
companies.team_shape: Product company, so the Pega 'team' is the product itself. The India GenAI Engineering org is led by Shyam Agarwal (Sr. Director, Hyderabad, Jan 2026, previously 16+ years leading India UI/Mobile/Integration/Robotics engineering) and Santosh Hegde (Director, ML & AI, Bengaluru, since Sep 2024). Under them sit Senior Principal engineers such as Md Azaz Ali and Krishna Rastogi (both 2026 moves into GenAI), with Principals and Software Engineers below. Separate Consulting and Client Success orgs deliver for customers from Hyderabad.
companies.what_they_build: Pega's own agentic AI: Agentic Case Processing, RAG/knowledge search, agent-to-agent and MCP integrations, DocAI, the GenAI Assistant Service, generative-evaluation and guardrail frameworks, and agent orchestration in 'Pega Vibe'. The 2–4-year Software Engineer role builds these capabilities with Pega rules and works with ML engineers.
companies.vibe: Strong learning culture and AI focus; many reviewers describe a 9-to-5 rhythm. Free lunch and dinner reported. Hybrid with 3 office days and a strict 60% attendance rule (Blind, Jun 2026).
companies.ratings: AmbitionBox 3.6/5 (357 reviews; WLB 3.7, promotions 2.9). Glassdoor WLB 3.8. Blind 3.3 (WLB 3.9, management 2.9).
companies.watch_outs: Recurring complaints about favouritism and politics among long-tenured managers, slow promotions and occasional layoffs. Consulting roles report leave depending on client approval.
companies.your_angle: The best band fit found (2–4 years, CSA + CSSA, Bengaluru). You would build the platform rather than use it, which is rare. Be honest that your GenAI work is tooling, not production LLM platforms.

Other Pega leaders: Gurushankar C N (Engineering Manager / Chapter Lead – Pega, Fraud & Scam, CLSA) and Resmi Raveendran (Manager – Pega). NEW: CBA India is building ASB's India engineering capability (REQ266311): squads embedded in ASB tribes and chapters holding the craft. The first Pega squad for ASB was posted on 14 Oct 2026: Engineering Manager REQ266820 plus Senior Software Engineers REQ266821 and REQ266822. CBA India is led by MD & CEO Shubha Iyer.
companies.what_they_build: Customer Decision Hub decisioning: 620+ 'Next Best Conversations' delivered for retail banking; CBA's Customer Engagement Engine runs on Pega CDH with about 200 models and about 200 ms decisions. Also Pega CLM/KYC for Institutional Banking & Markets. The new ASB squad covers case management, integrations (APIs, events, async patterns) and Pega architecture. ASB's stated agenda is to scale Pega across decisioning, workflow, lending and financial crime; it is also setting up a Pega CoE in NZ and has Customer Service, KYC, lending and payments apps on Pega.
companies.vibe: 40% office attendance per month (several 2025–2026 reviews); cab and shuttle provided; strong AI branding (#1 APAC bank in the Evident AI Index); graduate Launch Pad programme. Blind WLB 4.4.
companies.ratings: Blind 3.5 (21 reviews; WLB 4.4, management 3.0). Glassdoor WFH benefit 4.2. PrepNPlaced 2.69 across 973 reviews (career growth 2.21 lowest, salary 3.64 highest).
companies.watch_outs: Manyata is a long commute for many. No free meals. Some reviewers cite limited growth paths and leadership comparing itself to big tech. One engineer left after 7 months for Booking (Oct 2025).
companies.your_angle: Interview call received (10 Nov 2026). You'd be a founding member of a new squad. Your AU/NZ market experience, Kafka/async/replay work and collections domain map directly to the posting. Gaps: 5+ years asked, and Constellation/Pega Cloud/KYC/Customer Service are preferred. Watch the down-level risk (Software Engineer about ₹24–26L vs Senior about ₹33–40L).

companies.vibe: Relaxed 9-to-6 rhythm, no micromanagement and about 26–27 leave days. Hybrid with 3 office days a week (some teams alternate weeks).

companies.watch_outs: Slow growth and minimum increments; 'orthodox' Indian management; repetitive work. Some Deere Pega work is staffed through Coforge, so check the legal employer.
companies.your_angle: The closest domain to yours (collections), with a new collections leader on the business side, which may bring change. Pune-weighted.
